text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Hanshin Racecourse.
The day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, who will be crowned
the "Queen" here at Hanshin this autumn!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Facing off against the currently red-hot Lucky Lilac is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You, the undefeated Oaks Umamusume, and Chrono Genesis, the Umamusume of the long-sought Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
How will this cross-generational Tiara showdown unfold!?
Please wait just a moment longer for the post time!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Chrono-chan and Loves-chan.
They're as popular as ever, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"There's a strange air of expectation lingering around, you know?
Like, 'Maybe she'll win today.'"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm gonna dive headfirst—
right into that kind of mood!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That I am the Umamusume meant to become the "Queen."
choice_data_list: I'll be there to witness the moment of your comeback.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Please look forward to watchin' from the front row, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "The time has finally come, Chrono-chan. Let us clash with everything we have in our running...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And today, I'm going to become it!
Following the Oaks, an undefeated "Queen"!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I will not yield.
Today, I will etch my name into history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Consecutive victories in the Shuka Sho and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
Chrono Genesis is the 'Queen' heralding the dawn of a new era...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Looks like you two are fully fired up, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono & Loves
text_block_list.text: Miss Lala...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Lookin' forward to workin' with ya today.
I'll be givin' it everythin' I've got, so—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Come see for yourself who the real "queen" is.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's, just what I want...!
Just as I declared in summer, I'll show you
how much stronger my running has become...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll shower Lala-san with all the love I've cultivated♪
Make sure to catch it properly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fine by me. Let's see properly
just how good you really are.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Even so—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like Loves-chan and the others
are a wee bit different from me, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: The two of them fought tooth and nail and just shared the Tiara, but—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I'm different. After fighting for the Tiara, everything was completely overturned. I was shoved right into the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Knowing full well the darkness of that time—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I ain't goin' down that easy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much glory you achieve,
a single moment of intense brilliance
can completely overwrite it all—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I'll teach ya that that's just the reality of things.

text_block_list.name: Loves & Chrono
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Hanshin Racecourse is the place
where my reign as 'Queen' began."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's why, you two, watch over them
from behind today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――Our... triumphant return.
